metaDescription: Affordable, quality printing for the Shinawatra University community. Black-and-white and colour printing, with convenient campus delivery.
eyebrow: Printing made easy for uni life
heroBody: Friendly service, quality prints and fair prices for the Shinawatra University community. Whether it’s lecture notes or an assignment due tomorrow, we’re here to help.
campusNote: Currently accepting orders within the Shinawatra University main campus area only.
qualityText: Clear black-and-white prints and vibrant colour, with the details in your files reproduced as clearly as possible.
valueText: Know what your print order will cost before you send us your files.
deliveryText: Have your prints delivered to your accommodation or another convenient spot on campus.
servicesBody: From a single last-minute page to a full set of lecture notes, we make getting your prints easy.
pricingBody: Prices are per A4 sheet. Single-sided and double-sided printing are charged at the same rate.
samePrice: The same price applies to single-sided and double-sided printing
contactBody: Send us a message with your files, the number of copies you need and whether you’d prefer delivery. We’ll help you sort out the rest.
areaBody: We currently accept orders within the Shinawatra University main campus area, making it easier to get your prints when you need them.
